subject: HC reallocation & offer packaging for Q3 runtime hires
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: HC reallocation & offer packaging for Q3 runtime hires

Team,

Quick proposal to reallocate two open infra/SRE slots (req #INF-122, INF-124) into runtime-focused SWE roles this quarter. Rationale in the attached PDF (hc_realloc_proposal.pdf) but TL;DR:
- Observed 18% QoQ increase in request fanout for our hosted API; forecasts show sustained growth through Q4.
- Primary blockers for throughput/latency improvements are runtime feature work (KV cache, batching optimizations) rather than platform-only ops.
- Two roles: Runtime SWE (L5) and Runtime SWE (L4). We propose hiring L5 as immediate priority and the L4 as a close-second hire.

Ask: approval to move headcounts and sign off on offer bands below so recruiting can issue offers next week. Proposed comp bands (also in offer_band_matrix.csv):
- L5 Runtime SWE: base $205k - $235k; target offer $220k + RSU 0.6%
- L4 Runtime SWE: base $145k - $170k; target offer $155k + RSU 0.25%

Impact to infra oncall: Jonas and Marissa — I modelled minimal near-term risk if we keep one remaining infra SRE slot backfilled by contractor (estimated $12k/month) while we hire. If leadership prefers to keep both infra slots, we will delay by one quarter.

Please reply with: (1) go/no-go on HC reallocation, (2) sign-off on target offer bands, (3) any compliance/region notes (we'll recruit US-first).

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Dir, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 11:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: HC reallocation & offer packaging for Q3 runtime hires

Ben —

Thanks for the write-up. I support the move in principle but need clarity on two items before I greenlight the reallocation:
1) Full-year budget delta if we hire L5+L4 vs. filling the infra slots as SRE: please include benefits/bonus/onsite hiring costs.
2) Candidate grading guidance for recruiter: are these SDE II/III equivalents (we should map to bands in compensation ledger for headcount approvals).

Also, if we go forward, I want a conservative offer cadence: extend L5 at 85th percentile (to avoid losing to FAANG), and L4 at 70th percentile. If recruiting needs to push beyond those bands, escalate to finance.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP, Platform & Runtime

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 08:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: HC reallocation & offer packaging for Q3 runtime hires

Ben / team —

High level: I can provisionally approve reallocating one of the two infra slots to runtime (so net +1 runtime, -1 infra) but I want us to hold one infra slot for now. Operational reasons: the SRE backlog includes two critical migrations (VPC and observability ingestion) that will impact customer SLA if we under-resource ops during summer oncall rotations.

Requested items before I sign off on both:
- A short SLA risk assessment (attach sent: sla_risk_assessment.xlsx) with mitigation plan and named owners for mitigation steps.
- Clear budget delta for FY27 and FY28 (including recruiting fees).
- Hiring timeline: can we do L5 offer and start by Aug 1? If not, we should delay reallocation.

If the risk assessment shows we can mitigate with contractor coverage for a single quarter and keep the migration schedule intact, I will sign off on moving the second slot after review.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Farside Recruiting <talent@farsiderecruit.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 16:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: HC reallocation & offer packaging for Q3 runtime hires — updated plan and next steps

Thanks for the quick turns. Updated plan below based on feedback. Attaching offer_band_matrix.csv with final numbers and notes.

Decision summary:
- Approved: reallocate one infra headcount to Runtime L5 (INF-122 -> RNT-210).
- Hold: second infra slot remains reserved pending SLA mitigation review (Laura to confirm after reviewing sla_risk_assessment.xlsx).

Offer packaging (recruiting to proceed with L5 candidate outreach):
- Role: Runtime SWE (L5) — target offer: $220k base / 25% bonus target / RSU 0.6% (4-year cliff schedule). Total cash at target ~ $275k.
- Benchmarks: extend at 85th percentile for L5; approval to adjust up to +7% if counteroffer risk is high, but any adjustment beyond +7% requires finance sign-off.
- Hiring timeline: extend offer by June 8, candidate start target Aug 2.
- Recruiter partner: Farside Recruiting (talent@farsiderecruit.com) — fee cap approved at 18% for this role.

Operational mitigations while we hire L4:
- Jonas will lead a contractor engagement (2 months) to cover oncall rotations. Estimated run-rate: $12k/month.
- Marissa will shift two sprint cycles to prioritize the migration tasks with explicit deliverables; owners and checkpoints added in the attached SLA assessment.

Action items:
- Marissa: finalize contractor statement of work (SOW) and cost estimate by EOD Mon (2027-05-31).
- Recruiting (Farside): begin candidate outreach for L5 and provide shortlist by June 3.
- Ben: prepare offer packet and comp justification memo for finance escalation if we need +7% above band.

If Laura signs off on the SLA mitigation, we will bring the second slot up for a decision on June 7.

Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Dir, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: hc_realloc_proposal.pdf, sla_risk_assessment.xlsx, offer_band_matrix.csv
